node.statement: All hypotheses of lem-maincb-stage3-raw-merge are therefore present under this explicitly unpacked Stage-3 case, so it yields v with the asserted D_3*t isomorphism and unit bounds. Set u_3:=v in the composite raw-call record. From D_3<=D_* and t>=0, D_3*t<=D_*t; lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone preserves isomorphism for the same map and amplification family, and transitivity weakens the unit bound from D_3*t to D_*t.
